title: Te Kaiwhakapono Huna i te Marae o te Kaitukino
intro: I roto i ngā whare koura o te rangatira whakakake rawa atu e mōhiotia ana e te Quran — te wāhi i tautuhia ai e te whakakeke ki te Atua ia ture — kotahi te wairua i haereere i roto i te hunga whai mana, e huna ana i ngā mea ngaro tino morearea i te tirohanga whānui. I mau i tēnei tangata tētahi whakapono i tino rāhuitia i roto i aua taiepa, ā, ko te kitenga i a ia ka mate ia. Heoi, ka mura te whakapono pērā i te mura i raro i ngā pungarehu, ā, i te taenga mai o te wā, ka tangi te pono me te maia i wiri ai te turanga o te whare o te kaitukino.
clues: I noho ahau i roto i te porowhita o roto o te rangatira tino mana, tino whakapehapeha o tōku wā, i karapotia e te taonga papai me te awe.
I huna e ahau tōku whakapono pono i roto i tōku ngākau, i te wehi kei ora ahau i te hunga nanakia me te tukino.

I te wā i ruarua ai, i whakakorikoria ai taku iwi i te aroaro o te pono, ka tū atu ahau ki mua ki te whakatūpato i a rātou mō te aituā i pā ki ngā iwi o mua i whakakahore i ngā karere a tō rātou Ariki.
I whakamaharatia e au tōku iwi ki te kōrero mō tētahi taitama moemoeā i arohaina, i peia atu e ōna ake whanaunga, engari i eke ki te mana nui i tētahi whenua tawhiti.
I akiaki ahau i taku iwi kia kaua e whakarongo ki te rangatira nāna rātou i arahi ki te he, engari me tono atu kia aru mai rātou i ahau i te ara o te tika me te arataki.
I kōrerotia e au te pono ahakoa i whakawehi ngā akonga a te kaitukino ki te kōhatu i ahau ki te kohatu, ki te pei rānei i ahau i te whenua.

identity.label: Ko wai ahau?
options: Te Tangata Whakapono Huna i te Whānau o Parao
He Pāterea Manawanui i Tangi Matapo Tae noa ki te Hokinga Mai o Tāna Tama
He Pononga Pono i Ora ai tōna Mate Kiri
He Tama Hara i Whakakahore i te Pōwhiri a te Poropiti kia Eke ki te Āka
He Kaitukino Arohakore i Kīia he Atuatanga mō rātou anō
identity.answer: Te Tangata Whakapono Huna i te Whānau o Parao

trial.label: Whakamātautau/Takahanga
options: Te huna i te whakapono i roto i te kooti o te kaitukino
E pāngia ana e te matapo i ngā tau maha o te tangi
Te whakamatautauria e te ngaronga o te whānau me te mamae nui
Te hanga i tētahi kaipuke nui i te wā e tawaihia ana
Te manawanui ki te werawera o te ahi nui
trial.answer: Te huna i te whakapono i roto i te kooti o te kaitukino

location.label: Huānga Matua
options: Te whare o Parao
He tihi maunga i hangaia ai te āaka
He awaawa tapu i raro i Maunga Hinai
He māra ataahua me ngā awaawa e rua e rere ana
He torona karaihe i runga ake i te awa i raro i te whenua

outcome.label: Hua
options: Te tiakitanga atua i te wā i hinga ai ngā kaitukino
I tūtaki anō ki te whānau i muri i ngā tekau tau o te wehenga
I whakamanawanuitia, i ora anō, ā, i nui ake te whānau
I whakaorangia i runga i te poti i te wa i toremi ai te toenga o te ao
I whakaorangia i te mura ahi i runga i te whakahau a Allah
outcome.answer: Te tiakitanga atua i te wā i hinga ai ngā kaitukino

arabic: وَقَالَ ٱلَّذِىٓ ءَامَنَ يَـٰقَوْمِ ٱتَّبِعُونِ أَهْدِكُمْ سَبِيلَ ٱلرَّشَادِ
verse: And he who believed said, "O my people, follow me; I will guide you to the way of right conduct. (40:38)
